market_view: Calm regime: VIX 14.9, down 6.8% in 5 days. Gold, miners, chips and copper names rallied hard last week; oil fell 7.7% in 5 days; Middle East talks stalled.

oil_gas.catalyst: none (COP CEO change and upgrade are not XOM news; Trump and Pritzker windfall criticism is a negative)
oil_gas.reasoning: XOM has no positive leader-specific catalyst. Political windfall-profit pressure and stalled Hormuz talks cut both ways, and the oil move is already priced.

gold_miners.catalyst: Barrick and Newmont reach agreement on the Nevada Gold Mines JV (Yahoo, 08-10 10:00): real but largely priced, NEM already +20.6% in 5 days and +7.2% on 08-07
gold_miners.reasoning: The JV settlement removes a dispute but has no clear one-sided effect, and the gold jump is priced. No NEM guidance or earnings news. Stay flat.

chips.catalyst: TSMC revenue +44.7% and capex guidance lifted (Yahoo); Nvidia up to $3B in Lancium for Stargate (Yahoo): supportive but not decisive and NVDA is +11.6% in 5 days
chips.reasoning: Positive AI-demand news is mostly priced after the rally and is not an NVDA-specific shock. Intel's share sale and Cuban's financing warning add noise.

pharma.catalyst: none (LLY items are a ChartMill technical screen and a listicle)
pharma.reasoning: No LLY-specific event; Pfizer and JNJ news is not about LLY. The Q2 pop is priced. Stay flat.

copper_uranium.reasoning: No FCX or copper headlines this period. FCX is +11% in 5 days and copper is near its high; no guidance or supply news.

would_change_my_mind: A leader-specific guidance raise, approval, supply shock or export-control change not yet reflected in price (for example NEM or FCX guidance, NVDA-specific news, XOM positive news).

handoff.what_changed: Gold jumped 2.3% on 08-07 and miners surged (NEM +7.2%); Barrick and Newmont settled their Nevada JV dispute. TSMC revenue was strong and capex guidance was lifted, Nvidia is investing in Lancium, and COP changed CEO with an upgrade. Oil fell 7.7% in 5 days and political windfall-profit criticism of oil majors continues.

oil_gas.why: No positive XOM catalyst; windfall criticism and stalled Hormuz talks cut both ways.

gold_miners.why: NEM JV settlement is largely priced after a 20% weekly surge; no guidance news.

chips.why: TSMC and Lancium news are supportive but priced after an 11.6% weekly NVDA rally.

pharma.why: No LLY-specific catalyst after the Q2 pop.

copper_uranium.why: No FCX-specific news; copper near its high and FCX up 11% in 5 days.

handoff.next_job: Next decision day: read this handoff first, then the new record; all five families are flat; look for leader-specific catalysts (XOM news, NEM earnings and guidance, NVDA news, FCX guidance, LLY filings); stay flat otherwise.
